results.snippet: Complete Form 1099-NEC, Nonemployee Compensation Businesses that pay more than $600 per year to an independent contractor must complete Form 1099-NEC and provide copies to both the IRS and the freelancer by the specified annual deadline.

results.snippet: How long do I keep records for independent contractors? Keep 1099-NEC, payment records, and related tax documentation at least four years for IRS purposes.
